create_runtime_with_environment: create a Runtime instance with a dm_control environment and optional policy callable
run_simulation_tick: run the simulation tick method to advance the environment by one frame
generate_default_action: generate a default action from an action spec using midpoint or boundary values
restart_simulation_episode: restart the simulation episode by resetting the environment model and data
query_runtime_state: query the Runtime state machine to check if the simulation is running or stopped
